label: NECESSARY_2 in KT for the root, from the T schema by T correspondence
description: T branch of the 'necessary' sense fork with its frame condition derived: the route's K node (root n box-existent, NECESSARY_2 in K, from the 25 route inputs), the OPEN T schema on the route's frame and the OPEN reading premise (box-existence in KT, and only that) give the fork node. Reflexivity of the frame is not assumed: the modal library's StandardCorrespondenceCertificate (proved by MODAL-STANDARD-CORRESPONDENCE-CERTIFICATE) turns the T schema into it. The three OPEN fork premises (coverage, exclusivity, side condition) are replaced by two OPEN premises. Without the T schema or the reading premise the branch fails (controls).
